rubric.description: (a) Traverses the elements of the given row and accumulates the sum
(b) Calls `rowSum` for the rows and compares the sums
(b) Tracks the index (not the sum) of the greatest row and uses a strict comparison so that ties keep the smaller index
(c) Creates a new array whose length is the number of columns
(c) Traverses all elements and adds each one to the correct column total, then returns the array
(a) Traverses the rows and, within each row, examines every element
(a) Determines correctly whether all elements of a row equal `player`
(a) Returns true as soon as a full row is found and false otherwise
(b) Visits the (up to) eight positions around the spot
(b) Excludes positions outside the array (checks both row and column bounds before accessing)
(b) Excludes the spot itself and counts only spots equal to `player`, returning the count
